speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To understand the cause of these symptoms, have you had any recent travel, contact with someone who has a chronic cough, or been to a region with endemic diseases?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming the severity of your weight loss and night sweats. To further narrow the differential, have you experienced any recent travel, or have you had close contact with anyone suffering from a chronic cough?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Tuberculosis.

The fixed nature of the supraclavicular lymph node enlargement, combined with your history of drenching night sweats, significant weight loss, abdominal pain, and fatigue, strongly points to Tuberculous Lymphadenitis. I will order a Chest X-ray to check for pulmonary involvement and request a lymph node biopsy for confirmation.
